questions.question: How did Masamichi Yaga create Atsuya?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Masamichi Yaga created a cursed corpse made out of Atsuya's nephew's soul information, because his younger sister wouldn't have been able to live without Takeru's support.

questions.question: Who did Atsuya save from Pseudo-Geto during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Atsuya later arrives just in time to save Kasumi Miwa from Pseudo-Geto from using Uzumaki and killing her.

questions.question: What did Atsuya say about Yuji Itadori during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Atsuya talks to Panda about how he thinks Yuji Itadori deserves the death penalty no matter what happens to Gojo.

questions.question: What did Atsuya use to free Panda's hands in the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Atsuya cuts the ropes bounding his hands together with his katana

questions.question: How did Kusakabe train Yuji before the showdown with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Kusakabe trained with Yuji (Who were both swapped into the other's bodies through Ui Ui's cursed technique), with Kusakabe gaining the upper hand on him telling Yuji to master his training already.

questions.question: What did Kusakabe use to protect Higuruma from Sukuna's slashes?
questions.subject: Atsuya Kusakabe/Synopsis

answer.item: Kusakabe used Simple Domain to protect Higuruma from Sukuna's slashes, vowing he would protect him with his life as his cursed technique would be the easiest way to kill Sukuna.
